name: Sangkil Lee
bio: Sangkil completed his B.S. and M.S. in Materials Science and Engineering from Yonsei University and began his PhD in MIT DMSE in 2025. Prior to joining the MIT Bioelectronics Group, he developed a nanogap-based capacitive platform for hydrogen sensing. His research focuses on designing magnetic nanosystems for neural sensing and for gene therapy that can be controlled by alternating magnetic fields. Outside the lab, he enjoys producing music and playing chess.
